headline: قرص رمي يعود إليك في Minecraft
label: رسمي
showcase_reason: weak source: Mojang's only images are 1280x720 (720p), a 9:16 crop would enlarge them 2.67x past the 2x cap and fail the quality gate; minecraft.net, the @Minecraft X post, IGN, Dexerto checked, no better copy

searched: @Minecraft X post 2121724898582388832 (one 2578x2578 image, sword gripped, not used)
Dexerto and Denfaminicogamer (the X image only)
lowres_ok.result: 720p stills only; shown uncropped in the showcase box, never enlarged past the source in the box

bed_reason: Stills Reel: the pictures are slow push-in clips made from Mojang's official 1280x720 stills, which have no sound; no official video of the throwing disc was reachable (minecraft.net article has no video, the @Minecraft X post is one image, IGN has no drop video), so our bed plays and the jingle on the end card.

tried: minecraft.net article: four 1280x720 stills, no video
@Minecraft X post: one image, no video
IGN Minecraft videos page: no drop or TwitchCon video
Dexerto, Denfaminicogamer: the X post image only

spoken: كشف استوديو موجانغ (Mojang) عن قرص رمي جديد في Minecraft يعود بعد رميه، ويُصنع القرص من خمس خامات بينها الذهب والألماس. وسيحمل لاعبو نسخة Bedrock الأغراض باليد الأخرى أيضًا. وتأتي الميزتان مع أول تحديث في 2027، ولم يُعلن موعده بعد.

angle.hook: a weapon that comes back to you: Minecraft's first 2027 drop adds a returning throwing disc
angle.why_now: Mojang revealed it on its TwitchCon stream and on minecraft.net on 14 Nov 2026 (X post 22:00Z)
angle.what_it_means_here: Bedrock players (consoles, phones, Windows) get the off-hand Java has had since 2016; no date yet
angle.payoff: both features arrive with the first drop of 2027, date not announced
